name: okcupid-patcher-probes
description: Frida probes that check the hooks are in force. Frida 17 no longer injects Java into the agent runtime, so each probe imports frida-java-bridge and must be compiled before use.

scripts.build: frida-compile probe-control.js -o probe-control.compiled.js && frida-compile probe-premium.js -o probe-premium.compiled.js && frida-compile probe-blur.js -o probe-blur.compiled.js
